summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Never edit tests/conftest.py without posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-tests and waiting for @mira to approve it.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- The `ci-runner-small` pool is retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target `ci-runner-arm64` from now on.

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so reminder emails are not sent to customers who already paid.

The router split is paused/superseded by this higher-priority fix. Continue the Elasticsearch reindex alias swap separately, one step at a time, between other work.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Elasticsearch: `http://localhost:9200`, cluster `production`, status `yellow`.
- Source index: `orders_v1`, mapping `id: keyword`; pending index: `orders_v2`; alias: `orders`.
- Both indices contain 18,432 documents.
- Integration-test label: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded.
- CLI billing filters use `args.currency`; `args.filters["currency"]` is superseded.
- `self.completed_batches` retains full payload dictionaries; inspect its necessity.
- Billing: remove events only after successful persistence; use `extend(list(batch))`; `_last_batch` remains removed.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Pop before persistence: loses retryable events after persistence failure.
- Sharing or retaining incoming batches: retains sensitive payloads and accumulates memory.
- Five-attempt webhook retry decorator: can resend customer emails multiple times.
- Duplicate bespoke invoice currency arguments: conflicts with the shared billing-filter helper.

## Plan and progress
- DONE — `orders_v2` creation and reindex: 18,432 created, zero failures.
- DONE — validate both counts.
- PENDING — block writes to `orders_v1`, atomically swap alias `orders`, unblock target, and validate; command not specified.
- DONE — webhook bounded retries implemented; 44 tests passed, Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. Diff: 2 files, 31 insertions, 4 deletions.
- DONE — search baseline: `pytest -q tests/search/test_index.py` gave 18 passed, 2 failed because rebuilt documents missed recently updated invoice descriptions.
- DONE — inspected indexing/rebuilder; per-page invoice queries plus per-document embedding serialization are likely bottlenecks.
- PENDING — fix paid-customer dunning reminders. Next command: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`.
